Note: The expected annual earnings for unpaid activities are an estimate of the value of the activity if done in the paid economy. To estimate this, we created a crosswalk of similar activities from care jobs in the paid sector and assumed the median wage value based on the crosswalk. Some state/group combinations lack sufficient responses for accurate estimates and are excluded from the chart.
